name: Lens Position Anomaly of Genetic Origin

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Hereditary Lens Dislocation

criteria.description: Presence of ectopia lentis confirmed by slit-lamp examination or imaging
Positive family history of lens dislocation or related connective tissue disorders
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with lens position anomalies (e.g., FBN1, ADAMTSL4)
Presence of secondary ocular complications such as glaucoma or myopia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ectopia lentis plus either a positive family history or pathogenic genetic variant
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is supportive but not mandatory if clinical and family history criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ectopia lentis (dislocation or subluxation of the lens)
searchTerms: lens out of place in eye

pathognomonic.symptomName: Iridodonesis (tremulousness of the iris due to lens instability)
searchTerms: iris wobbling due to lens instability

common.symptomName: High myopia due to lens displacement
searchTerms: blurred distance vision from lens shift

common.symptomName: Secondary glaucoma from lens-induced angle closure
Visual acuity reduction due to lens malposition
searchTerms: reduced sight due to lens problem

occasional.symptomName: Irregular astigmatism caused by lens displacement
searchTerms: uneven corneal shape causing blurry vision

occasional.symptomName: Retinal detachment secondary to lens instability
searchTerms: retina detachment due to lens issues
eye retina separation secondary to lens

occasional.symptomName: Corneal endothelial damage from lens contact
searchTerms: eye surface injury from lens touching cornea
corneal cell loss due to lens

occasional.symptomName: Photophobia due to abnormal lens position

searchTerms: cloudy lens after surgery or trauma

imaging: Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (OCT) demonstrating lens position
genetic: Pathogenic variants in FBN1 gene (Marfan syndrome related)
Mutations in ADAMTSL4 gene associated with isolated ectopia lentis
Other connective tissue disorder gene mutations affecting zonular fibers
other: Family pedigree analysis showing autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance patterns

distinguishingFeatures: Systemic features including skeletal abnormalities, aortic root dilation
Presence of ectopia lentis with systemic connective tissue involvement
Elevated homocysteine levels and systemic thromboembolic events
Lens anomalies with systemic skeletal abnormalities

redFlags: Sudden vision loss indicating lens dislocation into anterior chamber
Elevated intraocular pressure suggesting secondary glaucoma
Family history of early-onset lens dislocation or connective tissue disorders
